It contains: the entry and a fixed-frame invocation ABI on stdin/stdout, the memory intrinsics, cd-core's lifecycle transitions and finality, worker- authority reconstruction over a bounded per-context evidence ring, a table of N contexts, and the dispatch that runs one command to completion on one context. It contains no reporter, no size table, no strings, no replay, no codec, and no measurement ops. N is a build-time constant read from the environment, so bytes-per-context is the slope of

Evidence egress is not in the hot floor.

A world root is born once.
There is no second BOOT and no re-mark, so

a foreign root cannot enter through the ABI, and cd-core's ForeignProvenance path is unreachable from outside. It stays covered by cd-floor's internal witness. 4. What the numbers do not say

Hardware-counter figures are this CPU, this frequency, this day. The
dynamic receipt is stamped for that reason and must not be diffed.
p50/p99 are log2 buckets. A bucket is a factor-of-two range; do not quote
its lower edge as the percentile.

cycles. They differ by the frequency ratio and are reported in separate columns.
One image and one stack on one core is measured. **Nothing is measured
across cores**, and nothing about shadow promotion, which the order excluded and which remains the INDETERMINATE problem.
"Contexts scale to N" here means bytes and independence. Throughput per
core under a realistic mix of operations is not measured; the bench workload is attach/detach only.
A thread-or-process comparison was not run. The honest comparison needs
its own harness and its own round.
5. Instrument defects found while building R1
The single-slot battery expected the wrong thing.

slot 0 is detached before the finalize step, so the finalize must be refused NotAttached, not admitted. The first version of the battery wrote the multi-slot expectation into the one-slot case and the receipt's PROBLEMS section caught it. Fixed; the one-slot witness now names the refusal it expects.
LLVM picks a different encoding when
N is an immediate that fits a shorter form, and unrolls at N=1. Recorded as a note, not a failure: the floor does not grow with N.
The hardware-counter probe read zero on its first run
enable-on-exec flag was set at the wrong bit. Found by the agreement check against ptrace; fixed before any figure was recorded.
